dockerfile:
FROM node:20-bookworm-slim
RUN useradd -m -u 1000 dev
WORKDIR /workspace
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl=7.88.1 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN npm install -g express@4.19.2
ENV NODE_ENV="production"
ENV APP_PORT="8080"
RUN npm install
USER dev
